sentences.text: The fossil record includes a nearly complete skeleton that remains articulated.

The holotype, cataloged as AGM 16793, was discovered in the Yixian Formation of China.
The specific name dongi honors the paleontologist Dong Zhiming.

Taxonomists classify this animal as an iguanodontian ornithopod dinosaur.
